title: Bonds payable — Lark Inc.
instructions: On January 1, Year 1, Lark Inc. issued **$500,000** face value, **5%**, 5-year bonds with interest paid annually on December 31. The market rate at issuance was **6%**. Lark uses the effective interest method. Round to the nearest dollar.

rows.label: The bonds were issued at a
rows.explanation: The stated rate (5%) is below the market rate (6%), so investors pay less than face.

rows.label: Interest expense each year compared with the prior year
rows.explanation: The carrying amount rises as the discount is amortized, so 6% × carrying amount rises.

rows.label: Interest expense compared with cash interest paid
rows.explanation: With a discount, expense = cash + discount amortization.

parts.prompt: Record the December 31, Year 1 interest payment.
